verdict.rationale: Round modeling is a fair question for an equity and cap-table product like Ledgy, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only cap-table record-keeping, reporting, permissions, equity plans and API access. Nothing documents round or scenario modeling, dilution calculation, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership, or sharing scenarios with counsel and investors.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
